title: The 10 elements
at a hawker
centre
tag_line: Tag the one who chopes with tissue.

items.Yang Wood: Orders for the whole table without asking.
items.Yin Wood: Chopes a seat with tissue in 0.3 seconds.
items.Yang Fire: Chats with the auntie like they're old friends.
items.Yin Fire: Remembers everyone's order. Even 'no spring onion'.
items.Yang Earth: Same stall. Same order. Twelve years.
items.Yang Metal: Joins the longest queue. 'Must be good one.'
items.Yin Metal: Checks the hygiene grade before sitting down.
items.Yin Water: Knows which stall closes early on Tuesday.

caption:
Tag the one who chopes with tissue 😂

Every element has its hawker centre habit. Which one is you, and which one is your makan kaki?

Your element comes from the day you were born, not your zodiac animal. Find yours free at the link in bio.
